summary: Dry-run rollout simulation — policy imports, promotions, bundle rollouts, mirror-source changes, trust-root changes, and route/egress expansions previewed before they widen privilege or feature access — bound back to the frozen admin-plane matrix and simulated identically for shell, CLI/headless, Help/About, support export, and release evidence across the managed-cloud, self-hosted, sovereign/air-gapped, and mirrored/offline profiles. Widening is gated harder than tightening, and a profile's managed claim auto-narrows when simulation, mirror, or endpoint-posture evidence goes stale.

profiles.summary: Managed-cloud profile: the control plane is online and posture is fresh; widening changes preview a staged ring rollout while tightening can apply immediately.

scenarios.title: Import managed policy bundle that shortens telemetry retention
scenarios.summary: A pure tightening: importing the next managed bundle shortens diagnostics retention. It can apply immediately and revert instantly.

impacted_endpoints.label: Managed fleet
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: Retention window shortens; no access is broadened.

impacted_features.effect_note: Telemetry retention is shortened from 90 to 30 days.

scenarios.review_note: Restriction only: a single admin review clears it, it may apply at once, and it reverts instantly.

scenarios.title: Open a new egress class for a managed integration
scenarios.summary: A mixed change: it opens a new egress class while removing an unused one. Because it broadens egress it needs security review, a staged ring rollout, and a staged rollback.

impacted_endpoints.label: Managed fleet
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: The new egress class reaches endpoints ring by ring after review.

impacted_features.effect_note: A new egress destination class is reachable from managed endpoints.

scenarios.review_note: New egress widens reach: security/compliance sign-off, a staged ring rollout, and a staged rollback are required before promotion.

scenarios.title: Promote a staged bundle that allows a new AI provider
scenarios.summary: A widening promotion: it allows a new AI provider. It needs security/compliance review, a staged rollout, and a staged rollback.

impacted_endpoints.label: Managed fleet
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: The new provider becomes selectable ring by ring after review.

impacted_features.effect_note: A new AI provider is added to the approved managed list.

scenarios.review_note: A new provider widens data flow: security/compliance sign-off and a staged rollout are required before promotion.

profiles.claim_note: All simulation, mirror, and endpoint-posture evidence is fresh; the managed claim is confirmed.

profiles.summary: Self-hosted profile: the customer operates the control plane; a trust-root rotation is held for a boundary recheck and a registry-source change previews a staged rollout.

scenarios.title: Roll out a self-hosted bundle that narrows egress to internal endpoints
scenarios.summary: A tightening rollout: it narrows egress to customer-internal endpoints. A single admin review clears it, staged by ring for safety.

impacted_endpoints.label: Self-hosted fleet
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: Egress narrows to internal endpoints; nothing is broadened.

impacted_features.effect_note: Egress is restricted to self-hosted endpoints.

scenarios.review_note: Restriction only: a single admin review clears it; it is staged by ring for operational safety, not because it broadens access.

scenarios.title: Rotate the customer trust root
scenarios.summary: A trust-root rotation: it changes the root every signature verifies against, so it is held pending a boundary recheck before it can apply.

impacted_endpoints.label: Self-hosted fleet
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: Verification is held until the new root is rechecked at the boundary.

impacted_features.effect_note: The trust root every bundle verifies against is replaced.

scenarios.review_note: A trust-root change is the strongest widening: it is blocked pending a boundary recheck, arrives only as a signed bundle, and reverts only via a signed rollback bundle.

scenarios.title: Import a bundle that grants a new capability and changes the registry source
scenarios.summary: A widening import: it grants a new capability permission and repoints the extension registry. Both broaden supply, so it needs security review and a staged rollout.

impacted_endpoints.label: Self-hosted fleet
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: The new capability and registry source reach endpoints ring by ring.

impacted_features.effect_note: A new capability permission is granted to managed launches.
The extension registry source is repointed.

scenarios.review_note: A new permission and a registry-source change both widen supply: security/compliance sign-off and a staged rollout are required.

profiles.claim_note: All simulation, mirror, and endpoint-posture evidence is fresh; the managed claim is confirmed.

profiles.summary: Sovereign / air-gapped profile: no outbound control plane; every change arrives as a signed offline bundle, the managed claim auto-narrows because simulation and posture evidence are past their windows, and a stale promotion is held.

scenarios.title: Import a fresh signed offline bundle that narrows the provider list
scenarios.summary: A tightening import: a freshly signed offline bundle narrows the allowed provider list. It arrives only as a signed bundle and reverts via a signed rollback bundle.

impacted_endpoints.label: Sovereign image
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: The provider list narrows; no access is broadened.

impacted_features.effect_note: The allowed offline provider list is narrowed.

scenarios.review_note: Restriction only: a single admin review clears it; pinned-signed delivery and a signed rollback are inherent to the air-gapped profile, not extra gating for widening.

scenarios.title: Rotate the pinned offline trust root
scenarios.summary: A trust-root rotation on an air-gapped image: it changes the pinned offline root, so it is held for security/compliance review before the signed bundle is accepted.

impacted_endpoints.label: Sovereign image
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: Verification is held until the rotated root is reviewed and accepted.

impacted_features.effect_note: The pinned offline trust root is replaced.

scenarios.review_note: A trust-root change widens trust: security/compliance sign-off is required, delivery is a signed bundle, and rollback is a signed bundle.

scenarios.title: Promote a staged offline bundle whose simulation evidence is stale
scenarios.summary: A tightening promotion that is blocked: its simulation evidence is past the soft-refresh window, so it can never read as safe to promote until a fresh signed bundle is imported.

impacted_endpoints.label: Sovereign image
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: The promotion is held; the last-known value is shown unconfirmed.

impacted_features.effect_note: The promotion is held because its simulation evidence is stale.

scenarios.review_note: Stale evidence: the promotion is blocked until a fresh signed bundle refreshes the simulation, never auto-promoted on a stale preview.

profiles.claim_note: Managed claim auto-narrowed off confirmed because evidence is stale: simulation_evidence_stale, endpoint_posture_stale.

profiles.summary: Mirrored / offline profile: the managed source is offline; the managed claim auto-narrows to last-known because the mirror is stale, and a mirror-source change previews a staged rollout.

scenarios.title: Switch to the backup mirror source
scenarios.summary: A widening change: repointing to a backup mirror source changes where managed truth is fetched from, so it needs security review and a staged rollout, and is held while the current mirror is stale.

impacted_endpoints.label: Mirror-backed fleet
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: Endpoints would resync from the backup source ring by ring after review.

impacted_features.effect_note: The mirror source managed bundles are fetched from is repointed.

scenarios.review_note: A mirror-source change widens where truth comes from: security review and a staged rollout are required, and it is held while the mirror is stale.

scenarios.title: Apply the last-synced mirrored bundle tightening
scenarios.summary: A tightening from the last-synced mirror: a diagnostics restriction. It may apply immediately and reverts instantly, but the result is labeled last-known while the mirror is offline.

impacted_endpoints.label: Mirror-backed fleet
impacted_endpoints.impact_note: The restriction applies from the last sync; the value stays labeled last-known.

impacted_features.effect_note: A diagnostics restriction from the last mirror sync is applied.

scenarios.review_note: Restriction only: a single admin review clears it and it reverts instantly; the value is labeled last-known while the mirror is offline.

profiles.claim_note: Managed claim auto-narrowed off confirmed because evidence is stale: mirror_freshness_stale.

invariants.statement: Every endpoint posture state a scenario shows — before and after — and every per-profile claim state is one the frozen admin-plane matrix declares applicable for the endpoint-posture surface, so the simulation cannot drift from the contract.
Each profile binds the policy-diff and endpoint-posture surfaces, and both are present in the matrix, locally explainable, and typed rather than portal-only.

Every widening or mixed scenario clears at least dual-control review, a staged (non-immediate) rollout, a non-instant rollback, and names a widening dimension; every pure tightening needs at most a single admin review and names no widening dimension.
At least one tightening scenario across the bundle is a light, immediately-applicable restriction with no more than a single admin review, so simple restrictions are not held to the widening floor.
Every scenario is a dry-run preview that names at least one impacted endpoint and feature, a review requirement, a staged-rollout requirement, and a rollback path before any promotion.
A scenario whose own simulation evidence is stale is held (blocked for stale evidence) and never read as safe to promote.
A scenario blocked pending a boundary recheck reports the boundary-recheck outcome and a pinned, signed-only delivery, and vice versa, so a boundary block is never silently promotable.

A profile's managed claim reads confirmed only when its simulation, mirror, and endpoint-posture evidence are all fresh; when any is stale the claim downgrades off confirmed and names exactly which dimension went stale.
Each profile's reported simulation freshness is the stalest of its scenarios, so a single stale scenario cannot hide behind fresher siblings.
A scenario names at least one widening dimension exactly when it widens or mixes, and none when it only tightens or has no effect.
A scenario flags an impacted feature as newly widened only when the change itself widens or mixes, so a tightening never claims to broaden a feature.
The bundle simulates the managed-cloud, self-hosted, sovereign/air-gapped, and mirrored/offline profiles.
Every rollout flow — policy import, promotion, bundle rollout, mirror-source change, trust-root change, and route/egress expansion — is simulated somewhere in the bundle.
Every widening dimension — new permission, new egress class, new AI provider, registry-source change, and trust-root change — is simulated somewhere in the bundle.

Each profile is one typed packet consumed identically by shell, CLI/headless, Help/About, support export, and release evidence, so the simulated blast radius is identical across surfaces by construction.
Profile ids, scenario ids, and endpoint refs are unique within their scope, so a consumer can resolve any object by a stable id.
Every stable profile, scenario, and endpoint id is an opaque token with no URL scheme or absolute path, so the bundle is safe to embed in a support export verbatim.
